slots.label: Sharing in a ratio
entries: Sharing in a ratio: two children share $48 in the ratio 2:3 - split the money into 2 parts for child A and 3 parts for child B, 5 equal parts in all.
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

slots.label: Watch out: 3:2 is not 3/2 of the whole
entries: Watch out: 3:2 is not 3/2 of the whole: the parts are counted out of the 5 parts of the whole, so 3 parts is 3/5 of the whole, never 3/2 of it.
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

slots.label: One part, then multiply
entries: One part, then multiply: 5 equal parts share $48, so 1 part = $9.60 - then multiply: A gets 2 x $9.60 = $19.20 and B gets 3 x $9.60 = $28.80.
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

slots.label: The takeaway
entries: The takeaway: to share in a ratio, add the parts to find the whole in parts, divide to find one part, then multiply for each share.
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

slots.label: Ratio
entries: A comparison of parts of one whole: 2:3 means 2 parts for one share and 3 parts for the other, with every part the same size.
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

slots.label: Part
entries: One equal piece of the split whole: when $48 is shared in 2:3 there are 5 parts, and one part is $9.60.
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

slots.label: Whole
entries: The full amount being shared: in sharing $48 in the ratio 2:3 the whole is $48, split into 5 equal parts.
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

slots.label: Share
entries: The amount one person gets: the number of parts they take multiplied by one part, such as 3 x $9.60 = $28.80.
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.
